def process(load_F_SS_phospho):
    import pandas as pd
    df = load_F_SS_phospho.copy()

    # Ensure numeric
    for col in ["FDR.phos", "FDR.prot"]:
        if col in df.columns:
            df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce')

    # Use phospho FDR as the primary 'FDR' since it's explicitly present; fall back to prot if needed
    fdr_col = "FDR.phos" if "FDR.phos" in df.columns else "FDR.prot"
    d = df[["Gene", fdr_col]].rename(columns={fdr_col: "FDR"})

    cbx3 = d.loc[d["Gene"].astype(str).str.upper().eq("CBX3"), "FDR"].dropna()
    rest = d.loc[~d["Gene"].astype(str).str.upper().eq("CBX3"), "FDR"].dropna()

    out = pd.DataFrame([
        {
            "fdr_column_used": fdr_col,
            "cbx3_n": int(cbx3.shape[0]),
            "rest_n": int(rest.shape[0]),
            "cbx3_mean_fdr": float(cbx3.mean()) if cbx3.shape[0] else float('nan'),
            "rest_mean_fdr": float(rest.mean()) if rest.shape[0] else float('nan'),
            "difference_cbx3_minus_rest": float(cbx3.mean() - rest.mean()) if cbx3.shape[0] else float('nan')
        }
    ])
    return out

operators.customDisplayName: Compute mean FDR for CBX3 vs all other genes in F-SS-phospho sheet using FDR.phos (primary), and report difference (CBX3 - rest) along with counts.
